name: get_session_command_logs
description:
Get the stdout, stderr, and error output entries of a command in a session. The tool reads the log stream until it ends before returning, and very large logs are sampled (first and last entries).

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId}/logs --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cmdId.description: The unique identifier of the command to stream logs for.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session containing the command.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
